acceptance_criteria.criterion: M1 bounded decision inventory and initial fail-closed regression coverage (partial milestone, not full Issue #588 acceptance)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Partial M1-only inventory and ten new adversarial parameterized cases; no behavior change, 105 tests pass. Remaining M1 adversarial cases and M2-M7 are not claimed complete.

defect_families.evidence: Inspected ready-without-complete-hostile-review against M1 docs/tests only: A candidate is admitted for review only when exact-head-bound repository-owned state proves the complete base->HEAD range was hostile-reviewed against the governing Issue acceptance criteria and every applicable recurring-defect family, with no unresolved blocking finding. No production authority or gating logic changed; 105 focused tests passed.

Inspected candidate-must-pass-canonical-preflight-before-pr-publication against M1 docs/tests only: A candidate may be pushed only through the repository pre-push safety boundary; the full canonical pytest proof runs exactly once in the hosted exact-HEAD Pre-PR stage, and a Draft PR may be opened only after that hosted proof succeeds. Focused tests are diagnostic evidence and never substitute for the hosted canonical proof. No production authority or gating logic changed; 105 focused tests passed.

Inspected tracked-governance-asset-not-loadable-at-its-path against M1 docs/tests only: Every tracked governance asset resolves to a path its declared consumer can actually load, and no tracked path carries characters that the consumer's own path grammar rejects. A tracked asset its consumer cannot load contributes no enforcement, and its absence must be a machine-detected condition rather than a silent one. No production authority or gating logic changed; 105 focused tests passed.

Inspected external-precondition-asserted-inside-deterministic-test-lane against M1 docs/tests only: The deterministic validation lane asserts only on repository-owned state. A precondition owned outside the repository -- an Issue body, a remote API response, a live network endpoint -- is validated on the runtime path that actually consumes it and reported as its own attributable signal, never as a deterministic-lane assertion whose failure is indistinguishable from a defect in the change under test. No production authority or gating logic changed; 105 focused tests passed.

Inspected stale-exact-head-review-request-reconcile-terminal-error-loop against M1 docs/tests only: A pre-ready hostile-review request binds the reviewed candidate content and exact PR HEAD. Mutation invalidates prior review evidence and blocks Ready/merge. The trusted GitHub-native reconcile must represent missing/stale review as a durable, actionable blocked/waiting state, distinguish it from execution/security failures, and recover after a new authenticated exact-head request without rerun loops, forged approvals or unbounded polling. No production authority or gating logic changed; 105 focused tests passed.
